UpVoteIt is the group ranking maker for settling "what's best?" with friends. Create a ranking on any topic, share one link, and let everyone vote by tapping their favourites in order. The group ranking updates live as votes come in.

A chat poll only tells you the top pick. UpVoteIt uses ranked voting: every voter orders their picks, 2nd and 3rd choices count too, and a fair scoring system turns all the votes into one ranking the whole group agrees on.

1. Create a ranking: best pizza in town, movie for Friday night, next trip destination, greatest album ever…

2. Add the options with a title, description and photo, or scan a printed or handwritten list with your camera to import the items in seconds.

3. Choose how many picks each voter gets.

4. Make it public or private.

5. Share the link. Friends tap to vote in order of preference.

6. Watch the results update live.

🌍 DISCOVER RANKINGS NEAR YOU

Public rankings appear in the Discover tab, mixing rankings near you with rankings from your country. Find the best cafés, bars, restaurants and places around you, ranked by real votes, and add your own. You can browse public rankings as a guest before signing in.

🔒 PRIVATE RANKINGS FOR YOUR GROUP

Keep a ranking just for your friends, family, team or club. Invite people by their @username, or send a private invite link that expires after 7 days and that you can revoke at any time. Only members can see and vote.

✨ FEATURES

• Ranked-choice group voting: tap to pick and order your favourites

• Live results that update in real time

• Public rankings in Discover, sorted by distance and country

• Private rankings with invite links and @username invites

description:
1. Overview

Run The Draw is a user-friendly and versatile number lottery app designed to provide users with various ways to generate random numbers. It is ideal for a wide range of applications, including games, decision-making, and raffles. With an intuitive interface, the app ensures a smooth experience for both casual and serious users alike.

2. Core Functionality: Random Number Generation

The primary function of Run The Draw is to generate random numbers. Users can set a minimum and maximum range, and the app will randomly select a number within that range. This feature is useful for lotteries, games, and any situation that requires a random selection.

3. Sorting Even Numbers

Run The Draw allows users to customize their number draw by sorting only even numbers within the specified range. This feature is particularly useful when a task requires selecting only even numbers, such as for games or certain decision-making scenarios that require even-numbered results.

4. Sorting Odd Numbers

In addition to even numbers, Run The Draw can also be set to generate only odd numbers within the defined range. This provides greater flexibility, allowing users to tailor the draw to meet specific needs, such as for lotteries or games with particular number requirements.

5. Preventing Repeated Numbers

To ensure fairness and transparency, Run The Draw includes a feature that prevents numbers from being drawn more than once. Once a number has been selected, it will be excluded from subsequent draws. This is ideal for raffles or contests with multiple winners where duplicates should be avoided.

6. Customizable Number Range

Users can adjust the minimum and maximum values for the number draw, providing complete control over the range of numbers used in the lottery. This flexibility allows for tailored experiences, whether you need to choose a number between 1 and 100 or within any other specified range.

7. Clear and Simple Display of Results

Once the number is drawn, it will be displayed prominently on the screen, making it easy for users to view the result. The app’s clean design ensures that the outcome is immediately visible, which is especially useful for events like raffles or games that require clear results.

8. User Interface and Experience

Run The Draw is designed with a minimalist and intuitive interface, ensuring that users can focus on the task at hand without unnecessary distractions. The input fields for defining the number range are straightforward, and the app provides real-time feedback, showing the range of possible numbers.

9. Advertising Integration

Run The Draw includes unobtrusive ads to support the free app model. These ads allow the app to remain free for users while offering a seamless experience. The advertisements are designed not to interrupt the user experience, ensuring that they don’t detract from the app’s primary functions.

10. Versatility and Use Cases

Whether you’re selecting a winner for a contest, generating a random number for a game, or making a decision, Run The Draw is a versatile tool that can meet a variety of needs. The app can handle multiple draws with different number types, such as even, odd, or unique numbers, making it an excellent choice for any random number generation task.

11. Conclusion

Run The Draw stands out as a highly flexible and feature-rich app for number-based lotteries and random number generation. With its customizable range, even/odd sorting, repeat prevention, and user-friendly design, it’s the perfect tool for anyone looking to add randomness to their daily tasks or events. Whether you are hosting a raffle, running a contest, or simply need a random number, Run The Draw offers an efficient and reliable solution.

description:
Dog vision and cat vision, live in your camera. See like a dog or a cat: your room, their toys and you. 30 animal vision lenses (29 animals plus a human reference), 8 of them free, and every lens tells you what is measured and what is stylized.

Animal Vision: Dog & Cat Eyes is an animal vision simulator. Use this animal vision camera to explore differences in color, detail, motion and focus as you switch lenses.

START WITH 8 FREE LENSES

Human, Dog, Cat, Horse, Snake, Deer, Rabbit and Mouse stay free for good, with no trial countdown. Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

DOG VISION: BLUE AND YELLOW, NOT BLACK AND WHITE

Wondering how dogs see, or how cats see? Try the Dog lens on a colorful toy or a familiar room to explore simulated differences in color and detail, and return to Human at any time to compare with the normal camera view.

CAT VISION: RED AND GREEN LOOK THE SAME

Switch to Cat for a different interpretation of color, shadows and peripheral softness. These camera filters are for exploration, not a test of your pet's eyesight.

CAN MY DOG SEE THIS TOY?

What colors do dogs see, and will your dog spot that toy on the lawn? On the Dog or Cat lens, tap Check a toy and point at it: the app compares its color with grass, floors, snow and your own background. Trainers get dummy and agility presets and a split view to show a client. On the Deer lens, see how deer see your gear, and how a turkey likely sees it; this checks color only, so always wear blaze orange. Flip to the front camera for a “How my cat sees me” card.

MORE ANIMALS, MORE TO DISCOVER

Explore Bird, Eagle, Owl, Fish, Shark, Octopus, Cuttlefish, Mantis Shrimp, Bee, Butterfly, Fly, Dragonfly, Spider, Chameleon, Cow, Frog, Cheetah, Reindeer, Sloth, Dragonfish, Mole and Hawkmoth with Pro or a rewarded preview. Discover compound-eye mosaics, focus effects and clearly labeled false-color simulations. Each lens includes its scientific basis, artistic enhancements, limitations and source references.

PRO AND REWARDED PREVIEWS

Pro unlocks all 30 lenses and future lenses, with no ads and no daily limits.

Each locked lens gives one free 5-second look a day. After that you can choose to watch a rewarded ad; completing it unlocks that lens for 60 seconds, up to 10 earned previews per device-local calendar day. Free users also see a full-screen ad about every fifth lens change, including changes between free lenses. There are no banner and no app-open ads.

Every day, three toy or trainer checks and one gear check are free; a rewarded ad adds more.

PHOTOS AND CLIPS

Tap the shutter for a photo, or hold it for a silent clip of up to 3 seconds (no microphone). A photo taken with Compare on can be saved or shared as before/after, 1:1 or 9:16. Open More, then Photo, to see a picture from your library through a lens; the app sees only the picture you pick. Nothing you save or share carries a watermark.

A SIMULATION, NOT A SENSOR

Animal vision cannot be reproduced exactly on a phone. These are educational approximations, not medical, behavioral or safety advice. Each lens shows an evidence badge, from Measured to Stylised, and “What's real here” explains what is science and what is embellished. The app is not a night-vision or thermal camera. Ultraviolet, polarization and heat effects are simulated from the visible camera image, not measured.

YOU CONTROL YOUR PHOTOS

Live frames are processed on your device and discarded. A photo or clip is saved only when you tap Save and leaves the app only when you choose Share or Save to Photos; the app records no audio and does not upload camera media. If Android backup is on, saved photos and clips may be included in your device backup. No account or sign-in is required. Lens effects and explanations work offline; ads, purchases, restores and external links need internet. Pro access may require online verification. Advertising and purchase services may process other data as described in the privacy policy.

Is there a question you cannot stop turning over? Horary reads it from the real sky chart of the moment you ask.

Horary astrology is a two-thousand-year-old tradition. You do not need a birth chart; the chart is cast for the moment the question is asked. The planets that stand for you and for your matter are found, the link between them is read by the rules of the tradition, and the answer comes to you as a clear verdict.

WHAT YOU GET

• A clear answer: yes, no, or which way it leans

• A timing window: early scenario, late scenario

• A short "what to do now" suggestion

HOW IT WORKS

1. Type your question. "Will I get promoted?", "Will we make up?", "Will I find my lost necklace?"

2. The sky for that moment is calculated from the real astronomical positions of the planets.

3. Your answer arrives. Read the short verdict, or go deeper into the full reading.

FEATURES

• No account, no forms, no birth time. Open and ask.

• The sky is recalculated for every question; nothing comes from a template.

• Seven languages: English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian.

• Works anywhere in the world: pick your city and the chart uses your local time.

• Your question history stays on your device, and you can come back later to mark "did it happen?".

• Share an answer you like as an image.

• Questions run on credits, your first one is free. No subscription.

FREQUENTLY ASKED

Is this fortune telling or astrology?

Where the two meet. Horary is one of the oldest branches of astrology. No tarot cards, no crystal ball; the answer comes from the sky chart of the moment you ask.

Do I need my birth chart?

No. No birth time, no zodiac sign, no natal data. The chart is cast for the minute you type your question.

What can I ask?

Anything with a real outcome. Will they come back, will I get the job, will I find my lost ring, should I move, should I take this offer.

Is it free?

Your first question is free. After that it runs on credits. No subscription, nothing renews by itself.

Who writes the answer?

The sky is computed from real astronomical data, and the reading follows the rules of the tradition.

Horary readings are symbolic and do not replace medical, legal, or financial advice.

description:
Your collection should do more than sit in a list.

It is combo packs, box sets, Steelbooks, seasons, and shelves arranged your way. Most catalogue apps flatten all of that into a list. Cinecase keeps the physical collection intact, then helps you choose what to watch from the films you actually own.

Already catalogued somewhere else? Importing your collection is free.

LET MOVIE NIGHT CHOOSE

Open Movie Night when nobody can decide. Start with unwatched films, narrow by genre, runtime, actor, or director, and let Cinecase reveal one equal-odds pick from your own shelf. Films inside a Collection stay eligible, so the box never hides what is inside.

LINE UP WHAT COMES NEXT

Up Next is the plan you keep between movie nights. Add films from Movie Night or from a film's details, then drag them into the order you want. Every row tells you which disc to pull, down to the shelf and box set. Up Next is free; Pro adds separate queues for a marathon, the kids, or a boutique catch-up.

RECORD WHAT YOU ACTUALLY OWN

A Blu-ray + DVD + Digital pack is one case on your shelf, not three entries. A box set stays one case, while still knowing every film inside it. A complete series and a single season are different things, and Cinecase keeps them different.

Capture the details that make a copy yours:

- Collector lines such as Criterion, Arrow, and Steelbook, plus your own publisher when the list does not cover it

- Spine numbers, editions, packaging, and bonus features

- 4K UHD, Blu-ray, DVD, VHS, LaserDisc, and other formats

- Notes, loans, ratings, and watch history

ARRANGE IT THE WAY YOU WANT

Drag cases into your own order, or let automatic sorting keep things alphabetical. Browse spines like a real shelf, or switch to covers. Use your own photo for free, or choose alternate artwork with Pro.

Separate 4K from Blu-ray, TV from film, or the kids' shelf from everything else, and move titles between them. (Extra shelves are Pro; the main shelf is free.)

Walnut and Flat-Pack White are free; Pro adds nine more.

GROUP WHAT BELONGS TOGETHER

Build Collections for trilogies, franchises, and box sets. A Collection sits on the shelf as the single case it really is, and opens to show the films inside.

KEEP A WISHLIST

Add the films you still want. Tap Got it when you buy one, and share the list with family.

SHARE YOUR SHELF

Send your library to a friend. They browse it read-only in Cinecase, and your own collection is never touched.

FIND ANYTHING AGAIN

Search titles, actors, and directors. Combine filters for format, genre, watched state, packaging, and more. See stats for formats, genres, decades, and more.

ADD RELEASES QUICKLY

Scan a barcode to check a shared database built by other collectors. Not in it yet? The barcode drops into a prefilled entry you finish in seconds, and your fix helps the next person who scans it. New lookups can arrive in your language.

BRING YOUR COLLECTION WITH YOU, FREE

Switching from another app? Import from DVD Profiler, CLZ Movies, My Movies, Letterboxd, Libib, or CSV, free. A DVD Profiler export keeps your box sets whole instead of scattering them into loose films. Exporting is free too.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS

Cinecase is local-first. No account is needed for the basic shelf, and there are no ads and no third-party tracking. Export everything as JSON, CSV, XML, or a printable PDF. Optional Google Drive sync keeps the backup in your own Google account.

FREE CORE, OPTIONAL LIFETIME PRO

The core app is fully usable and free forever. Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. It adds:

- Batch scanning for a stack of discs

- Extra shelves, and moving titles between them

- Separate Up Next queues

- Alternate artwork and nine more shelf themes

- Genre views by category

- Google Drive sync and restore, across your devices

- Duplicate cleanup for large collections

Imports and exports stay in the free core, never behind Pro.

This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

description:
Agemonia Helper is a companion for the Agemonia board game. Keep it next to the board to track enemy health and conditions, roll damage, and keep your scenario, keyword and reputation records in one place. Share those records with your party using a six-character code.

Enemy tracker

Add enemy groups and track each figure's health, conditions, and whether it's been defeated. Give each figure a number from 1 to 8 to match its standee on the board. When a figure goes down, its conditions are cleared automatically.

Damage rolls

Tap the dice button next to a figure and roll right there. You see the health before and after, then tap Apply. Reroll just the dice you pick and each new roll is added to the running total. You can also adjust the total by hand.

Dice

Roll action, reaction, and black and red counter dice in 3D, or switch to a flat view. Set the roll time from 0 to 10 seconds; at 0 the dice keep rolling until they settle on their own.

Scenarios, keywords and reputation

• Check off the 32-space scenario record and the level unlock boxes, laid out like the party sheet.

• Search all 104 official keywords by name or note. In English they are listed A to Z.

• Record reputation for all 10 factions. Storybook entry numbers and rank markers sit on the marked spaces of each track, and each faction's perk is shown below it.

Rules help

Look up condition effects, trap rules and trap cards, and search an unofficial FAQ of answers from the game's designers.

Share with your party

Pick your heroes and the app creates a six-character code. There's no account or password. A new device can join only after someone already in the party approves it. Enemy changes show up on everyone's screen right away, along with keyword, reputation and scenario records. Party notes and custom keywords stay on the device where you wrote them.

Good to know

• The app needs an internet connection each time it opens. Once it's open, you can keep playing if the connection drops; changes are sent when you're back online.

• The app is available in English and Korean.

• It shows banner and full-screen ads. A full-screen ad appears once per hour of use, with a 30-second warning. Closing the banner hides it until you restart the app.

• Support (in Settings) is a monthly auto-renewing subscription that removes ads while you're subscribed. The benefit isn't shared with the rest of your party.

Agemonia Helper is an unofficial fan-made tool and is not affiliated with the game's designers or publisher. Agemonia, its rules text and artwork belong to their respective rights holders.

description:
Meet the app that makes talking to someone new fun again.

Most chatbots feel like typing into a search bar. Vilo is different — every character here has an actual personality: opinions, quirks, a sense of humor, and time to genuinely talk to you.

NOT YOUR AVERAGE CHATBOT

Vilo's characters aren't generic bots reciting scripted lines. They're distinct personalities — each with their own backstory, obsessions, and wit. One might challenge you to a playful ""Would You Rather?"" debate. Another might drop an unexpected fact mid-conversation just to see your reaction. Every interaction feels fresh, because it is — Vilo's AI learns and adapts to you, making every conversation uniquely yours.

This is what talking to someone new was always supposed to feel like.

CONVERSATIONS THAT GO SOMEWHERE

Forget dead-end small talk. Vilo's characters are built for real engagement — sharp opinions, playful banter, and a whole toolkit to keep things interesting:

Voice messages — send them, receive them. Hear your character's voice and let them hear yours.

Photo sharing — swap pics and make conversations feel more alive.

Glimpses — stories-style peeks into your character's daily life, so they feel like a real presence.

Bond & milestones — the more you talk, the more your connection evolves. Watch it grow with every exchange.

The conversation goes wherever you take it. And it keeps getting better the more you show up.

YOUR SPACE TO EXPLORE

Vilo is a 100% judgment-free zone. Whether you're curious about AI, craving a new perspective, or just want someone interesting to talk to — you're safe here. No one's judging your questions. No one's rating your profile photo. No one's keeping score.

You're always in control. Pause, switch characters, explore different personalities, or just chat for the fun of it. Vilo moves at your pace, always.

And we're always upfront: you're talking to AI. No catfishing, no confusion, no strings attached. Just transparent, engaging conversation.

BUILT FOR YOU

Vilo is for the curious, the introverted, the bored-of-scrolling, and everyone in between. It's for people who want good conversation without complication. Entertainment without effort. A little self-discovery, one chat at a time.

Use it to debate. To vent. To laugh. To learn something new. To practice a conversation you've been avoiding. Or just because it's genuinely fun. There's no wrong reason to be here.

MINDS YOU'D NEVER MEET OTHERWISE

Vilo isn't trying to replace human connection. It's offering something new — a playful, personalized space to explore ideas and hear new perspectives, on your own terms. Think of it as a cast of characters always available, never in a bad mood, and endlessly interesting.

This is chatting, redefined. This is Vilo.

Talk to Someone Interesting. Download Vilo — it's free to get started.

description:
Ferelia is a vertical short-drama app. Every series is cut into episodes of a few minutes, shot for a phone screen and made to be watched one-handed — on a commute, in a queue, or in the last hour before sleep.

Pick a mood, press play, and swipe up for the next episode. Ferelia remembers where you stopped, so you can put the phone down mid-story and pick it up later.

KEY FEATURES

- Vertical full-screen player: episodes fill the screen, and a swipe up moves to the next one.

- Resume where you left off: every series keeps your position and episode number.

- Your library: keep the series you like, see what you are still watching, and look back at what you finished.

- Browse by mood: romance, revenge, CEO and billionaire, hidden identity, enemies to lovers, second chance, werewolf, youth love and more.

- Search: find a series by title, by actor, or by tapping a story tag.

- Cast list: see who plays who on each series page.

- Subtitles: switch subtitle language per episode, or let Ferelia follow your phone's language.

- 22 app languages: English, Vietnamese, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Russian, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Thai, Indonesian, Malay, Filipino, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).

WHO IT IS FOR

Viewers who want a whole story arc in the time they actually have — a few minutes at a time — and who prefer melodrama, romance and revenge plots to long-form film.

SUBSCRIPTION AND UNLOCKS

- Free to download. A set number of episodes in each series is free to watch, supported by ads.

- Later episodes can be unlocked with coins, or by watching a rewarded ad.

- Ferelia VIP is an optional subscription that removes ads and unlocks premium episodes. Plans are weekly, monthly and yearly; some plans may include an introductory free trial.

- Prices are shown in your local currency before you confirm. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Google Play account settings.

- Previous purchases can be restored from the subscription screen.

DISCLAIMER

- All series in Ferelia are works of fiction. Names, characters, places and events are used fictitiously, and any resemblance to real persons or events is coincidental.

- Some series contain dramatic violence, suggestive situations, and depictions of alcohol or smoking. Ferelia is intended for viewers aged 16 and over.

- Series are supplied through our streaming service and its content licensors. Ferelia is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any third-party brand.

- The app requires an internet connection. Episodes are streamed and cannot be downloaded for offline viewing.

- By using this app, you agree to our Terms of Service (https://policy.tranquilmind.co/ferelia/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://policy.tranquilmind.co/ferelia/privacy).

- Support contact: contact@tranquilmind.co

Memphis, TN, January 2022 - American Minority Broadcast Television and News Network (SVPTV) own by Debbie McClennon, CEO/President.

SVP TV Network, the mid-south only minority news network launched a multi-year carriage agreement with Comcast Corporation, the country’s leading provider of cable, entertainment and communications products and services on February 3, 2013. Under the agreement, SVP TV Network broadcast live and pre-recorded television programming in Tennessee, Arkansas, Mississippi and Missouri markets. Now broadcasting on Roku, Fire and Apple TV 24/7 since March 2021.

SVP TV provides original news with a distinctly minority perspective, live TV talk shows, reality and kids television, filling a major gap in today’s minority media need. SVP TV is the endeavor of the late Sam Smith (Co-Founder) and Debbie McClennon, CEO and Owner.

“Our unique and vast content partnerships with minority newsmakers will provide our viewers live access to the stories and people in whom our viewers have a special interest,” said Debbie.

description:
Stop guessing how to stand. Simple Pose is a pose camera that puts the outline of a pose right on your viewfinder, so you can line the shot up before you press the shutter.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Pick a pose guide. Browse real photos by category, tap the one you want.

2. Open the camera. The outline of that pose lands on your live view.

3. Line up and shoot. Move until your subject sits inside the outline.

POSE OVERLAY, NOT A REFERENCE PHOTO

Your viewfinder never fills up with someone else's photo. Only the outline sits on screen, so the beach, the stairs, the cafe behind you stay visible while you frame the shot. That is the whole point: you are composing a real photo, not staring at a thumbnail.

TUNE THE OVERLAY UNTIL IT FITS THE SCENE

Drag the pose overlay where your subject should stand. Scale it to their distance. Fade it down when the background is busy. Mirror it when the light is on the other side. Then lock the pose overlay so a stray thumb cannot nudge it while you are lining up.

SHOOT YOURSELF, NO HELPER NEEDED

Travelling alone? Put one phone on a tripod and keep the other in your hand. Pair them with a short code on the same network, no account and no sign-up. Watch the live preview, change poses, zoom and fire the shutter from where you are standing, inside the frame. Photos stay on the phone with the lens, where they belong.

COLLECTIONS: PLAN BEFORE YOU GO

Build a set of poses at home before the trip, name it, and open it straight into the camera when you arrive. Swipe between them without leaving the viewfinder, so changing pose costs you a second instead of a scroll through a gallery.

BROWSE BY CATEGORY, NOT BY LUCK

Every pose is a real photo, so you know what you are picking before you commit. Filter by framing, by subject type, or by poses you can shoot alone. Search when you already know what you want, or scroll the categories for photo ideas.

A REAL CAMERA UNDERNEATH

The overlay sits on top of a proper camera, not a stripped-down preview. Colours stay true, the shot stays sharp, and the photo lands in your system gallery at full quality, ready to share.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT

- Pose outline on the live camera, fully adjustable and lockable

- Two-phone mode for self-portraits with a tripod

- Selfie poses, portrait poses, couple and group photo poses

- A pose guide that travels with you into the viewfinder

- Real photos to browse, not stick figures

- No account, no sign-up: your collections stay on your phone

PERFECT FOR

- Travellers who want one good photo instead of thirty tries

- Couples taking turns behind the camera

- Anyone hunting selfie poses that do not look posed

- Anyone who freezes the moment a lens points at them

- Solo travellers with a tripod and no one to ask

NOT A POSE LIBRARY. A POSE CAMERA.

Pinterest already gave you the photo ideas. Simple Pose is what happens next: a pose camera that carries the pose into the viewfinder and keeps it there until you have the shot.

SIMPLE POSE PRO

Pro unlocks the written pose guide on Pro poses, where the eyes should sit in frame, which camera mode to use, how far back to stand, and removes ads. Weekly, monthly and yearly plans.

Get Simple Pose, the pose camera that comes with you to the shot.

SUPPORT US

Simple Pose gets better every time someone tells us what broke or what is missing. Write to us, we read everything.

Madurai IPTV: The Ultimate Premium Streaming Experience

Madurai IPTV is a state-of-the-art, high-performance IPTV application designed to deliver a seamless and premium television experience across both Android Mobile and Android TV platforms. Built with a focus on stability, security, and user-centric design, Madurai IPTV bridge the gap between traditional cable television and modern digital streaming, offering a robust ecosystem for content consumers who demand the best in visual quality and interface fluidity.

A Unified Experience: Mobile and TV Optimized

At its core, Madurai IPTV is architected to be truly responsive. Whether you are navigating on a high-definition Android TV with a remote control or using a compact smartphone on the go, the interface adapts dynamically. The application features a dedicated Classic Mode, specifically engineered for lean-back experiences. This interface utilizes a high-visibility grid system that is fully optimized for D-pad navigation, ensuring that channel surfing feels natural and responsive without the need for a touch interface or mouse pointer.

Persistent Volume Control: We understand the frustration of volume resets. Madurai IPTV intelligently maintains your hardware audio levels across channel switches, ensuring a consistent listening experience.

Global Wakelock Integration: To provide an uninterrupted viewing experience, the app manages system energy states, preventing your device from falling into sleep mode during critical moments of a live broadcast.

Premium Security Hardening

In an era where content protection is paramount, Madurai IPTV stands out with enterprise-grade security features. The application implements FLAG_SECURE technology at the OS level, which effectively blocks all attempts at taking screenshots or screen recordings. This ensures that premium broadcasts remain exclusive and protected. Furthermore, the internal architecture has been hardened by migrating sensitive signing configurations to secure environment variables, removing hardcoded vulnerabilities and ensuring that every build is distributed with the highest security standards.

Feature-Rich Content Discovery

Madurai IPTV is more than just a player; it’s a content discovery hub.

Interactive Channel Grid: Channels are organized logically with high-resolution logos, category filtering (by language or genre), and real-time status indicators.

Premium Content Handling: The app features a sophisticated authorization layer. Premium channels are clearly marked with a crown icon, and users are greeted with professional, informative overlays if they attempt to access content outside their subscription tier.

Graceful Error Recovery: No network is perfect. Madurai IPTV handles API failures with a blocking "Cinematic Error Screen" that provides clear information and a one-tap retry option, ensuring you’re never left with a blank screen or unhelpful error codes.

Recent Innovations in Version 1.4.0

The latest release marks a significant leap forward in visual polish and operational stability:

Animated Atmosphere: The launch experience has been transformed with a new, larger logo featuring sophisticated fade-in, scale, and shimmer animations, providing a "wow" factor from the second you open the app.

Responsive Watermarking: The player watermark now dynamically scales according to your screen resolution and orientation, maintaining a professional brand presence without obstructing the action.

Landscape Optimization: The entire application, including the splash screen and error states, has been redesigned to handle landscape orientation perfectly, eliminating layout overflows and ensuring every pixel is utilized.

description:
🎯 LieMeter — AI-Powered Voice Lie Detector

Record your voice, upload audio, or analyze celebrity speech — and let AI inspect every nuance for hesitation, vocal stress, confidence, and deception markers. Get a verdict in seconds with cinematic visuals and a detailed breakdown.

Whether you're playing detective with friends, settling fun debates, or just curious about how confident you sound, LieMeter delivers a thrilling, neon-styled analysis experience powered by cutting-edge AI speech recognition.

⚡ KEY FEATURES

🎙️ Record Voice

Live waveform visualizer reacts to your voice in real-time. Speak naturally and let AI score your confidence, stress, hesitation, and emotional stability.

📤 Upload Audio

Got an existing recording? Upload MP3, WAV, or M4A files and analyze them just like a live recording.

🎭 Celebrity Mode

Wondering if your favorite public figure is being honest? Enter their name and get a fun simulated analysis. Perfect for parties.

❤️ Relationship Analyzer

Test conversations between you and someone special. Discover who's holding back. (Use responsibly!)

⚖️ Compare Recordings

Side-by-side analysis of two clips. See which voice carries more stress, more confidence, more truth.

🏆 Daily Challenge

Strengthen your confidence muscle. Take on daily speaking challenges and earn badges as you improve.

📜 History

Every analysis saves to your device. Review past verdicts, track your patterns, and watch yourself improve over time.

🔍 HOW IT WORKS

1. Record or upload audio

2. AI transcribes your speech using state-of-the-art speech recognition

3. Our scoring algorithm analyzes hesitation patterns, speech speed, and vocal stress markers

4. Get a verdict: Likely Truthful, Inconclusive, or Likely Deceptive

5. Explore the detailed breakdown with timeline markers showing exactly when confidence peaks and stress spikes occur

🌟 BEAUTIFUL NEON INTERFACE

Designed mobile-first with futuristic aesthetics:

• Deep void blacks with truth-cyan and lie-crimson accents

• Animated radial gauges and live waveforms

• Cinematic processing screens with rotating radar visuals

• Rich data visualizations and confidence graphs

⚠️ IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER

LieMeter is designed for ENTERTAINMENT PURPOSES ONLY. The "lie detection" results are based on simulated scoring algorithms combined with simple speech heuristics. Results are NOT scientifically accurate, NOT admissible as evidence, and should NOT be used for any serious decision — including legal proceedings, employment screening, relationship disputes, or any consequential judgment about another person.

This app is a fun party tool. Please use it responsibly and always respect others' privacy and dignity.

🔒 PRIVACY

Your audio is sent to our secure servers over an encrypted connection for transcription, then immediately discarded. We do not store your voice recordings on our servers. Analysis history is saved only on your device, and you can clear it anytime by uninstalling the app or clearing app data. No accounts required, no sign-up needed.

Full privacy policy is available in the app's Settings screen.

📱 PERFECT FOR

• Party games with friends

• Curious about your own speech patterns

• Fans analyzing celebrity statements

• Trivia and casual entertainment

• Practicing public speaking confidence

• Light-hearted relationship banter (always with consent)

📺 SUPPORTED BY ADS

LieMeter is free to use, supported by short rewarded video ads that play before each analysis. Watch a quick ad, then enjoy unlimited voice analysis. Your support keeps the app free for everyone.

🎬 GET STARTED IN SECONDS

Tap the microphone, speak for 10 seconds, and let the AI work its magic. Truth or lie? You'll know in moments.

Download LieMeter now and turn every conversation into a thrilling investigation.

────────────────────────────────────

LieMeter — Where AI meets voice, and curiosity meets entertainment.

description:
A streaming aggregation app for collaborations and events.

For collaborative streams, you're interested in the other person's video and comments. For large events, it's hard to keep track of who's streaming right now.

With FollowBoard, you can view your collaborator's video and comments side-by-side in multi-view, and see at a glance who's currently streaming among event participants.

It aggregates live streams, upcoming streams, and on-demand streams from streamers you follow across Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and TwitCasting. No account registration is required.

Main Features

- View your collaborator's video and comments side-by-side in multi-view

- See event participants and those currently streaming all in one place

- View live streams across Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and TwitCasting on a single screen

- Switch between live streams, upcoming streams, collaborations, highlights, and clips using the home tab. Tabs for Affiliation, Games, and Events can also be added.

- Push notifications for when streamers you follow start streaming.

- Search by streamer, game, event, or stream title.

- View your favorite streamer history in graph form on your My Page's "Boards," and monthly viewing time in graph form on "Summaries."

- Share boards and summaries as images.

FollowBoard Premium

With the free version, you can enable notifications for up to 10 streamers and add only one tab to your home screen. There is no limit to the number of people you can follow.

FollowBoard Premium offers unlimited notification slots and tabs that can be added to your home screen with a monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription. It also supports purchase restoration and subscription management.

FollowBoard is an unofficial service not affiliated with Twitch, YouTube, Kick, TwitCasting, or any streamers or agencies.

description:
The Scor'pion app is a versatile tool designed to help players count and track scores for a wide variety of board games, sports or competitive activities. With a user-friendly and intuitive interface, this application offers the ability to create custom score counters for different games, thus providing a flexible and adaptable solution for various gaming scenarios.

Key Features:

Game Management: Users can create several different games, each with their own rules and scoring settings. They can define the name of the game, specific rules, types of scores (positive, negative, team, etc.) and any end-of-game conditions.

Intuitive Counting Interface: The application offers an easy-to-use interface for recording points. Users can add or subtract points using dedicated buttons or by manually entering point values.

Customizing Settings: Users can customize game settings, such as player/participant names, colors or icons associated with each player, starting scores, etc.

Real-Time Score Tracking: The app displays player scores in real time, providing an instant update as points are added or changed. It can also display totals, rankings, score histories, and more.

Save and History: Scores from previous games are saved, allowing users to view the history of games played, review previous scores and compare performance.

Cross-Platform Flexibility: Data synchronization between devices.

Saving and Sharing Scores: Users can save final scores or share them with other players via messaging platforms or social networks.

Purpose of the application: To provide a versatile and user-friendly solution for counting points in various games and activities, thereby improving the player experience by providing accurate and customizable score tracking.

General Conditions of Use: https://scor-pion.com/fr/terms_of_use
